title: IEEE Day 2026 at the American Center
summary: Uganda's student branches celebrated IEEE Day together. CUU received its certificate of approval.
audience: IEEE student branches from across Uganda

recap.summary: On 6 October 2026, IEEE student branches from across Uganda celebrated IEEE Day together at the American Center in Kabalagala, Kampala. Universities present included Makerere, Kyambogo, ISBAT, UCU, Ernest Cook, MUBS, KIU and Cavendish. Cavendish University Uganda was recognised as one of the branches being reborn and received an official certificate of approval. The day was given to engagement, sharing perspectives and networking between branches.
